notablePrerequisites:
Inquisitor Eisenhorn has at least 5 power each turn.
Inquisitor Eisenhorn cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Inquisitor Eisenhorn does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Inquisitor Eisenhorn as an attacker.
Inquisitor Eisenhorn deals combat damage, triggering itself, investigating at least five times.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Clue tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
